parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace. The length must be 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The name of the context store. The length must be 2 to 64 characters
parameters.help_zh: 上下文库名称，长度 2-64 字符
parameters.name: context_store_name

parameters.help_en: The structured filter conditions. The experience store supports scene. When __agentloopControl.mode is set to direct, hybrid, or agentic, multi-strategy recall with auditing is used, and you can pass source, callId, application, fields, channels, and budget simultaneously. The management plane can additionally pass contentStatus=all, active, candidate, gray, or deprecated to perform content retrieval, which includes disabled or unreviewed content and is not affected by store-level runtime switches. The API key runtime entry prohibits contentStatus and retains the original governance thresholds. The maximum value of timeoutMs is 60000. If mode is not passed, the existing semantics of fields, channels, minQualityScore, expansion, and debug are retained. When query is *, you can use includeCandidates, cursor, and offset to browse experiences (management plane only)
parameters.help_zh: 结构化过滤条件。经验库支持 scene；__agentloopControl.mode 为 direct/hybrid/agentic 时使用带审计的多策略召回，可同时传 source、callId、application、fields、channels、budget；管理面可另传 contentStatus=all/active/candidate/gray/deprecated 执行内容检索，包含未启用或未审核内容，不受库级运行时开关影响。API Key 运行时入口禁止 contentStatus 并保留原有治理门槛。timeoutMs 最大 60000。未传 mode 时保留既有 fields/channels/minQualityScore/expansion/debug 语义；query 为 * 时可使用 includeCandidates/cursor/offset 浏览经验（仅管理面）
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to apply structured formatting to the returned results
parameters.help_zh: 是否对返回结果做结构化格式化
parameters.name: formatted

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include memories with sourceState set to inactive. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含 sourceState=inactive 的记忆，默认 false
parameters.name: include_inactive

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned results (Top-N similarity)
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果数量上限（相似度 Top-N）
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The retrieval query text. Natural language is supported
parameters.help_zh: 检索查询文本，支持自然语言
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The retrieval options. The experience store supports normal and reranker (deterministic reranking). The memory store uses its own retrieval strategy. For real-time recall in the experience store, the limit ranges from 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 检索选项。经验库支持 normal 和 reranker（确定性重排）；记忆库沿用其检索策略。经验库实时召回 limit 范围为 1-20
parameters.name: retrieval_option

parameters.help_en: The recall scope. If this field conflicts with a field of the same name in filter, a 400 ScopeFilterConflict error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 召回 scope；与 filter 中同名字段冲突时返回 400 ScopeFilterConflict
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: Filters results by extraction strategy IDs. The conditions in the list are combined by using the OR operator. If this parameter is not passed, all strategies are recalled. An empty list returns a 400 error. If the format is valid but no matching IDs are found, an empty result is returned. Historical removed strategy IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 按提取策略 Id 过滤，列表内 OR；不传召回所有策略，空列表返回 400；格式合法但无匹配的 Id 返回空结果，支持历史已移除策略 Id
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en: The similarity threshold. Results with a score lower than this value are filtered out. Valid values: 0 to 1
parameters.help_zh: 相似度阈值，低于该值的结果将被过滤，取值范围 0-1
parameters.name: threshold
